website.description: nwmpublisher is a fork of gmpublisher for publishing, updating, downloading and extracting Garry's Mod addons on Windows, macOS and Linux.
website.heading: nwmpublisher
website.intro: A desktop tool for publishing, updating, downloading and extracting Garry's Mod Workshop addons. This fork removes automatic publisher branding and adds editing, management and cleanup tools.
website.platforms: Windows, macOS and Linux · Free and open source

website.feature_publish_body: Edit descriptions and changelogs with BBCode, syntax highlighting and live previews. Paste Markdown or import README and CHANGELOG files. Reuse templates and drafts, and update descriptions without uploading addon files again.
website.feature_manage_body: Filter and sort Workshop items, change visibility, and manage required addons. View subscriber counts, favourites, votes and other Workshop details.
website.feature_clean_body: Browse and extract addons, with previews for images, VTF textures, audio, video and text files. Save GMA packages without publishing, or download Workshop items and collections. Check disk usage with the size analyzer and choose which unsubscribed archives to move to Trash or delete.

website.install_windows: Run the installer. It installs separately from gmpublisher and offers to import your gmpublisher settings on first launch.
website.install_windows_portable: Portable: extract the ZIP and run nwmpublisher.exe. It shares settings with the installed app and requires Microsoft WebView2 Runtime.
website.install_macos: Open the disk image and drag nwmpublisher into Applications. If macOS blocks it, allow it in System Settings → Privacy & Security after the first launch attempt.
website.install_linux: Install the package for your distribution, or allow the AppImage to run as a program in its file properties. On Steam Deck, use Desktop Mode.
website.steam_note: Keep Steam running and signed in for Workshop features.
